The Smile-Assessment Funnel

Three steps. No guesswork, no pressure.

Most cosmetic visits stall because nobody explains the plan or the cost up front. This River North funnel fixes that: tell us your goal, get assessed, then decide with a written plan in hand.

01

Tell us your goal

Straighter teeth, a brighter smile, veneers, or a full refresh — say it in the booking form and we start from your goal, not a generic checklist.

02

Get assessed in River North

Your visit covers your smile, bite, and alignment, and whether Invisalign, veneers, or whitening fits best — including what would not help.

03

Decide with a plan

Leave with a clear treatment sequence and transparent pricing guidance, so the decision happens at home, not in the chair.

Pricing Guidance

Honest about cost, before you sit down

The studio does not publish a price list, and this page does not invent one. Instead, your assessment gives you exact, written pricing for your plan — and these are the factors that move it.

What shapes veneer and Invisalign pricing?

  • Scope: how many teeth are treated, and whether alignment, whitening, or veneers come first.
  • Complexity: bite and alignment starting points change aligner stages and lab work.
  • Materials and finish: the veneer material and shade work chosen in your smile design.
  • Sequence: staged treatment spreads work — and cost — across visits you approve in advance.

The rule: no treatment starts without an exact quote for your plan. Ask for it in the booking form and bring it home before deciding.
